name: Mayuzumi Reona
source: Reona is a young elite civil servant and Mecha pilot. Due to the notorious behavior of the Aozora Police Department, Reona was assigned by the Metropolitan Police Department to monitor their behavior. Reona takes hierarchy very seriously and initially treats other police officers with contempt, but this principle also makes her unable to disobey Hikari's orders. Junsaku sometimes worries about Reona's excessive police violence. Reona will also beat Junsaku when she is angered by the ridiculous behavior of other police officers.
